 On November 17, the Uruguay national team hosts the Dominican Republic in a friendly match that wraps up the year for both teams. 
 Receive Your Welcome Bonus Uruguay
 Uruguay comes into this match on a high note, having defeated Argentina 2-1 away on November 13. This was their best result of the autumn and the only defeat for the world champions during this period.
 The autumn has been productive overall: 1-3 against Japan, 4-1 in South Korea, 6-1 in India, and 2-1 against Argentina. Thirteen goals scored in four matches, with at least two goals in three of those games.
 In the summer at the World Cup, the picture was different: 1-1 with Saudi Arabia, 2-2 with Cape Verde, and 0-1 against Spain. The same players, but against opponents of a different level, leading to minimal scores.

 The Dominican Republic rarely plays at this level, and every match against a top 20 opponent is significant for them. Their last match was in June, where they lost 2-4 to Panama.
 In 2026, the national team has played three matches: a 1-1 draw with Cuba, a 2-2 draw with El Salvador, and a 2-4 loss to Panama. They can score, having netted seven goals in their last five matches, but they struggle to defend against stronger teams.
 In the autumn of 2025, the team lost 0-3 to Jordan and 0-1 to Uruguay, and in the CONCACAF qualifiers, they only secured wins against clear outsiders, such as a 5-0 victory over Dominica. The gap in class with today's opponent is the largest it has been all year.
 Statistics of Uruguay vs Dominican Republic Matches
 The teams faced each other a year ago in October 2025, also in Uruguay, where the hosts won 1-0. The match was tight, with Uruguay controlling possession but only managing to score once. This is the only meeting between the two sides, and it serves as a key argument against a large handicap.

 Uruguay -2.5 is offered at odds of 1.85 — the hosts scored thirteen goals in four autumn matches. 
 Over 3.5 goals is available at 1.86: in three of Uruguay's last four games, at least four goals were scored. 
 Uruguay's individual total over 2.5 goals is priced at 1.52 — the team scored three or more in their last two matches against lower-ranked opponents. 
 Uruguay's victory is priced at 1.10, a draw at 10.00, and a win for the guests at 23.00. 
 Uruguay -3.5 is offered at 2.70, and over 4.5 goals at 2.75. 
 Bookmaker Odds for the Match Uruguay vs Dominican Republic
 The outcome market sees it as a foregone conclusion: 1.10 for the hosts against 23.00 for the guests, with a draw at 10.00. This gives Uruguay about a ninety percent chance, and it's hard to argue with such an assessment given the class difference.
 The focus shifts to the score. The handicap (-2.5) at 1.85 suggests just over half the probability of winning by at least three goals. The market evaluates four goals scored between the two teams similarly. Uruguay's individual total over 2.5 goals at 1.52 is considered the most likely of the larger options — about two-thirds.
 Prediction for the Match Uruguay vs Dominican Republic on November 17
 The first argument for a large scoreline is Uruguay's autumn form. 6-1 in India, 4-1 in South Korea, and 2-1 against Argentina: the team scores a lot and does so against opponents of varying levels.
 The second is the guests' defense. The Dominicans conceded four to Panama, three to Jordan, and two each to El Salvador and Nicaragua. Against a team that just defeated the world champions on their home turf, this is a weak spot.
 The third is the calendar. For Uruguay, this is the last match of the year and a home game after a tough away trip: such matches are usually one-sided, and the squad will be competitive as the season wraps up.
 A counterargument is last year's meeting. A year ago, under similar circumstances, Uruguay only won 1-0, reminding us that a friendly match with low stakes can be tight. Therefore, the basis is the handicap (-2.5), rather than (-3.5): a three-goal cushion is something this attack regularly achieves, while four is more of a lottery.
 Uruguay scored thirteen goals in four autumn matches and just defeated Argentina away, while their opponent concedes two to four from teams much weaker.
